# Summary

The charter states that each member pays a yearly contribution. The amount of this contribution is fixed in the annex of the charter[[cite:obs-04536c869fd6462ccc0df9bad7da394a689af0d9 "Each member pays a yearly contribution; the amount is fixed in the annex of this charter."]].

According to the annex, the ordinary contribution is one hundred twenty (120) EUR, payable within January[[cite:obs-86f482fa3f2422e0889f8aec0e2e563c54dc567a "Ordinary contributions: one hundred twenty (120) EUR, payable within January."]].
